entities.name: Davriel Cane
entities.description: A mysterious diabolist, shadowmage and planeswalker, a former accountant who steals spells from minds and binds demons with contracts that can never be collected.

entities.name: Davriel's Entity
entities.description: A Worldsoul Entity hiding in Davriel's mind that promises unlimited power and may have given him his spark.

entities.name: Bog Entity
entities.description: Another Worldsoul Entity hidden on Innistrad, part of which Tacenda carries and which is made whole inside her.

entities.name: Tacenda
entities.description: A girl of Verlasen who blames Davriel for the geist attack, carries part of the Bog Entity and vanishes into nothing.

entities.name: Willia
entities.description: Tacenda's twin sister, who controls the Whisperers and is killed by Tacenda.

entities.name: Nameless Angel
entities.description: An angel killed after being struck by Emrakul's madness whose lingering soul urges Tacenda to use a new song.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: The Eldrazi titan whose madness struck Innistrad's angels.

entities.name: Lord Vaast
entities.description: A vampire of the Markov line, former ruler of the Approaches, removed by Davriel.

entities.name: Voluptara Highwater
entities.description: A wily demon of the Nexrix Flame Expanse who works as Davriel's accountant and must seduce him to take his soul.

entities.name: Crunchgnar
entities.description: A Hartmurt demon who serves as Davriel's bodyguard.

entities.name: Brerig
entities.description: A hunched demon bound to Davriel by a nearly unwinnable riddle; killed by hunters and cathars.

entities.name: Yledris
entities.description: A Nightreach demon bound to Davriel who claims to be Gutmorn's sibling; killed by hunters and cathars.

entities.name: Gutmorn
entities.description: A Nightreach demon bound to Davriel.

entities.name: Ob Nixilis
entities.description: A planeswalker whom Davriel tried to buddy up with and wants to recruit.

entities.name: Tibalt
entities.description: A half-devil who fought alongside Davriel in the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon who trapped planeswalkers on Ravnica with the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: The planeswalker who disabled the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The artifact Bolas used to trap planeswalkers on Ravnica, later disabled by Chandra.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Davriel hides as Lord of the Manor in Kessig.

entities.name: Verlasen
entities.description: A small town whose citizens are attacked by geists.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane where Davriel is trapped during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Whisperers
entities.description: Spirits from the Bog that attack the church and are controlled by Willia.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: Bolas's invasion of Ravnica in which Davriel was trapped and fought.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: A group of planeswalkers possibly seeking to recruit Davriel.

events.summary: Davriel steals the Entity by pulling it from the mind of a dying man, becoming hunted by the man's allies.
events.quote: Ever since stealing the Entity — pulling it from the mind of a dying man — Davriel had been able to sense its vast potential.

events.summary: Davriel draws on the Entity once, destroying both armies in a struggle to claim a throne.
events.quote: Davriel had used the power of the Entity only once, three years before his arrival on Innistrad.

events.summary: Davriel flees after sensing hunters drawn by his use of the Entity.
Davriel moves to Innistrad's Approaches and removes the previous ruler, Lord Vaast.
events.quote: He moved to the backwater of the Approaches - the most remote location on an already remote plane - and immediately removed the previous ruler, a vampire known as Lord Vaast of the Markov line.

events.summary: Verlasen is attacked by geists and Tacenda blames Davriel.
events.quote: Davriel was caught up in local events when the citizens of Verlasen were attacked by geists , and the girl Tacenda blamed him for orchestrating that attack.

events.summary: Davriel decides to help Tacenda find the impostor and restore the villagers' souls.
events.quote: Wanting to restore his peace, Davriel decided to help Tacenda find the imposter and restore the souls of the villagers to their stiffened bodies.

events.summary: Hunters and cathars from Thraben attack at the church, killing Davriel's demons Brerig and Yledris.
events.quote: a group of hunters and cathars from Thraben attacked the group, killing Davriel's demons Brerig and Yledris.

events.summary: Davriel's Entity confirms Tacenda carries part of the Bog Entity.
events.quote: Davriel's Entity confirmed that she carried part of the Bog Entity .

events.summary: Investigating the Bog, they find it empty and are besieged by Whisperers controlled by Willia.
events.quote: they were besieged by a host of Whisperers under the control of Tacenda's twin sister Willia .

events.summary: Tacenda defeats the Whisperers with a new song and absorbs their souls.
events.quote: With this warm, joyful song, Tacenda defeated the Whisperers and absorbed their souls.

events.summary: With Davriel's help Tacenda kills Willia and the Bog Entity is made whole inside her.
events.quote: With the help of Davriel, she also overcame and killed Willia.

events.summary: Davriel refuses to seize Tacenda's power as his Entity urges.
events.quote: Unwilling to become a creature that only caused death and destruction, Davriel refused to do it.
Not long after, Tacenda vanished into nothing.

events.summary: Davriel's Entity proclaims him unworthy and threatens to find another host.
events.quote: After Davriel refused to absorb the power of the second Entity, his own Entity proclaimed him unworthy and threatened to find another host.

events.summary: Davriel is visited by a group of planeswalkers, possibly the Gatewatch, seeking to recruit him.
events.quote: He was soon visited by a group of planeswalkers (possibly the Gatewatch ) looking to recruit him to their cause.

events.summary: Davriel is lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon and trapped by Bolas's use of the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Davriel was lured to Ravnica by the Interplanar Beacon , and immediately became trapped there due to Bolas 's use of the Immortal Sun .

events.summary: Davriel leads an army of demons and devils alongside Tibalt against the Dreadhorde.
events.quote: He led an army of demons and devils alongside the half- devil Tibalt .

events.summary: Davriel steals the Elderspell from an Eternal's mind.
events.quote: He also fought off an Eternal by stealing the Elderspell from its mind (which may enable him to cast it himself).

events.summary: Davriel escapes Ravnica once Chandra disables the Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Davriel survived the battle, as he was one of the many planeswalkers who left Ravnica and escaped to safety as soon as Chandra disabled the Immortal Sun.

relations.note: She works as his accountant under a contract.
relations.quote: she now works for Davriel as his accountant.
As his designated bodyguard, Crunchgnar earns Davriel's soul if Davriel doesn't die before age 65
To gain Davriel's soul, Brerig had to solve a riddle

relations.note: It hides in his mind, promising unlimited power.
relations.quote: A Worldsoul Entity is hiding in Davriel's mind, promising him unlimited power if he surrenders control.
they were besieged by a host of Whisperers under the control of Tacenda's twin sister Willia .
With the help of Davriel, she also overcame and killed Willia.
Researching the church of the Nameless Angel , Tacenda and Davriel discovered that the people inside had been able to resist the attacks by the Whisperers until a betrayer had let the geists in.
He led an army of demons and devils alongside the half- devil Tibalt .
